courseDetails.title: SQL практикум на базе MySQL (полный курс)
courseDetails.shortDescription: Спроектируем базу данных и разберём все типы запросов с примерами и заданиями.
courseDetails.longDescription:
Этот курс посвящён всестороннему изучению SQL и работе с базами данных на примере MySQL. Материал построен от основ к сложным темам и рассчитан на практическое освоение языка: от установки сервера и настройки окружения до проектирования базы, написания запросов и работы с транзакциями.

Мы начнём с установки MySQL и работы в терминале, познакомимся с графическими IDE (Workbench, DBeaver) и базовыми способами взаимодействия с сервером. Затем разберём структуру базы: первичные и внешние ключи, индексы, типы данных, правила именования объектов, таблицы-справочники и ER-диаграммы. Освоим команды DDL и DML, научимся добавлять, обновлять и удалять данные, фильтровать и сортировать записи, использовать агрегирующие функции, группировку, подзапросы и соединения.

Дальше курс охватывает расширенные возможности SQL: оконные и рекурсивные табличные выражения, представления, хранимые процедуры, пользовательские функции, триггеры, переменные и работу с транзакциями, блокировки и уровни изоляции. Особое внимание уделено анализу запросов (EXPLAIN), оптимизации и предотвращению SQL-инъекций.


Кому будет полезен курс:

  • новичкам, желающим изучить SQL с нуля;

  • студентам для практики проектирования и написания запросов;

  • ИТ-специалистам для систематизации знаний и расширения опыта работы с MySQL.


Чему вы научитесь:

  • проектировать базы данных и работать с таблицами;

  • писать различные SQL-запросы и оптимизировать их выполнение;

  • использовать процедуры, функции, триггеры и переменные;

  • работать с транзакциями, блокировками и анализировать выполнение запросов;

  • безопасно взаимодействовать с базой данных, предотвращая ошибки и SQL-инъекции.


Курс полностью практический, с примерами, заданиями и контрольными вопросами.


Добро пожаловать на курс и успехов в изучении SQL!
targetAudiences: Для новичков в SQL
Для студентов
Для ИТ-специалистов
Для всех интересующихся SQL

courseDetails.title: How to Jumpstart your Project Management career (Hindi)
courseDetails.shortDescription: FROM Accidental Project Manager TO Excellent Project Manager
courseDetails.longDescription:
Neha was on cloud nine. She is promoted as Project Manager. She is assigned a project that is critical to the company. She is in a customer-facing role, and the success of this project will decide the fate of a long-term relationship with the customer.

She started working on the project and was confident it would accomplish its objectives.

Two months have passed, and one can see cracks developing in Neha's calm and composed demeanor.

Her team members seem to be arguing a lot in the team meetings, the customer is sending escalation emails to top management, and Neha's boss is unhappy about not receiving regular project updates from her.

Have you seen similar scenarios happening in your organization, OR do you see yourself in Neha, OR are you scared to take the PM responsibility for fear of failure?

This course would help you overcome the fears you might face as a first-time Project Manager. It will help you better manage your project, eventually making you successful in your new role.

If you lack formal project management training, it can be easy to get overwhelmed with this new responsibility. Accidental project managers often need a fast-track learning program to give them the confidence to see projects through to successful delivery. They need to grow critical project management competencies and learn how to overcome the biggest challenges on projects.

In this course, I will share ten steps to jumpstart your PM career without worrying too much about the nitty-gritty of PM. These tips will make a big difference in your experience when starting. If you are considering a career in project management, this course provides ten tips for success in your PM career. Whether you are handling your first project as an accidental project manager or wish to achieve higher levels of success in your next project, this course is an ideal match for you.

From my experience, Becoming a PM for the first time is like being left in a jungle, where you have to learn to find your way, hunt for food, train and shield your herd from external dangers, and keep the jungle king happy. Also, on the journey, there are a lot of landmines that you need to avoid as they can blow you and your herd.

Sounds Familiar!

Don't worry; each one of us PMs had or will traverse this jungle many times in our career.

My course will give you enough tips to traverse this jungle and build your confidence to emerge as a successful project manager.


I created this course from the webinar delivered earlier in the PMI forum.

Few Review comments on the webinar:

"Great webinar. I learned a lot. Especially about the leadership aspect of PMP and how important it is to foster an environment of collaboration and being able to identify a problem early before it becomes an emergency."

"Thank you. Very good points shared here. Very helpful!"

"Excellent presentation. The experience shared by Anju of the reasoning behind each of the tips, was really good."

"Great tips for anyone in project management, not just the newcomers!"
targetAudiences: It will help the first time Project Managers or Accidental Project Managers, who are given the PM responsibility with little or no training. These PMs do not have second chance to make mistakes. It is critical for them to succeed in their first project for their career growth. They need to take this fast track learning course as they have a real project to deliver right now.

If you’re considering a career in project management, this course provides tips for more success in your PM career. Great for new project managers or those who are thinking of taking the PM role. For the seasoned PM, it can still be useful as a refresher.
This course is useful for people who thinks that Managing a project is difficult work. You need to either require a lot of experience or need to be PMP certified to be a successful PM.
People who want to succeed in their PM job. They want their team, their manager and the customer should acknowledge a PMs contribution to the successful project

Şirkette İş Derecelendirmesi (Job Grading)

Kurs Açıklaması

PapaHR Academy'nin "Şirkette İş Derecelendirmesi" kursu; İK profesyonellerini ve organizasyon liderlerini, şirket içindeki pozisyonları etkin biçimde sınıflandırma ve değerlendirme becerisiyle donatmak üzere tasarlanmıştır. İş derecelendirmesi, rol hiyerarşisini tanımlayan ve iş tanımlarını piyasa ücret standartlarıyla hizalayan kritik bir İK aracıdır.

Kursun Öne Çıkan Özellikleri

Kapsamlı Müfredat — Kurs, Mike Pritula tarafından bizzat değerlendirilen pratik ödevlerle desteklenen 6 kayıtlı dersten oluşmaktadır. Ücret felsefesi, iş analizi, maaş yapıları, derecelendirme yöntemleri ve piyasa verisine dayalı ücret sistemleri kurma gibi konular ele alınmaktadır.

Sertifikasyon — Kursu ve ödevleri başarıyla tamamlayan katılımcılara, profesyonel kimliklerini güçlendiren bir diploma verilir.

Kurs Programı

1. Derecelendirmenin Özü ve İşletmeye Katkıları

Ücret felsefesini, iş hedefleriyle bağlantısını, derecelendirmenin faydalarını ve temel bir araç olarak iş analizini keşfedin.

2. Maaş ve Ücretlendirmenin Temelleri

Sabit ücret, dereceler ve aralıklar, analitik ve analitik olmayan iş değerlendirme yöntemleri ile ücret eşitliğini anlayın.

3. Derecelendirme Seçenekleri

Repertory Grid Yöntemi, faktöriyel analiz, katalog pozisyon eşleştirmesi ve popüler tekniklere genel bakışı öğrenin.

4. İş Derecelendirmesinde Adım Adım Süreç

Değerlendirme faktörlerini belirleyin, iş değerlendirmesi yapın, derece genişliklerini seçin ve kapsamlı bir derecelendirme sistemi oluşturun.

5. Dereceleri Piyasayla İlişkilendirme

Ücret piyasası araştırmalarının temellerini, sağlayıcı seçimini ve derecelendirme sistemini piyasa verileriyle nasıl ilişkilendireceğinizi keşfedin.

6. Derecelere Dayalı Ücret Sistemi Oluşturma

Ödeme politikası oluşturun, aralıklar belirleyin, bordro bütçelemesi yapın, kademeli maaş gözden geçirme matrisi geliştirin ve bordro analitiği uygulayın.

Bu Kurs Kime Göre?

Bu kurs; İK uzmanları, İK yöneticileri, departman yöneticileri ve şirket içinde etkili bir İK yönetim sistemi kurmak isteyen herkes için idealdir. Özellikle iş derecelendirme becerilerinde uzmanlaşmak, adil ücret sistemleri geliştirmek ve İK alanındaki profesyonel seviyesini yükseltmek isteyenler için büyük değer taşır.

Uzman Eğitimi — İş değerlendirme ve ücretlendirme stratejilerinde geniş deneyime sahip kıdemli bir İK lideri olan Mike Pritula'dan öğrenin.

Bu kursa kaydolarak, şirketinizde etkili iş derecelendirme sistemleri hayata geçirmek ve adil, rekabetçi ücret yapıları oluşturmak için gereken bilgi ve araçlara sahip olacaksınız.

Etkili Davranışsal Sorular Tasarlama — STAR (Durum, Görev, Eylem, Sonuç) yöntemini ve diğer yapılandırılmış teknikleri uygulayın.

Adayları Nesnel Değerlendirme — Yetkinlik bazlı puanlama rubriklerini hayata geçirin ve seçim sürecindeki önyargıyı minimize edin.

Yaygın Mülakat Hatalarından Kaçınma — Zayıf işe alım kararlarına yol açan önyargıları, tuzakları ve etkisiz soru yöntemlerini fark edin.

  • Yetkinlik bazlı yaklaşımla panel mülakatı yürütme

  • Yapılandırılmış karar alma için mülakat puan kartlarını kullanma

  • Aday değerlendirmelerinde bilinçdışı önyargıyı önleme

このコースには人工知能の活用が含まれています。

上級OSINTをマスターする：他の人には見えないものを発見せよ

ほとんどの人はオンライン検索が得意だと思っています — しかし、価値ある情報の95%が見えるところに隠されているとしたらどうでしょう？この実践的でわかりやすいコースでは、世界中のトップ採用担当者、マーケター、調査員、ジャーナリストが使用する強力なオープンソースインテリジェンス（OSINT）ツールと技術を使って、その隠された層を明らかにする方法を学びます。

人を探したり、身元を確認したり、連絡先を調べたり、オンラインデータの深い層にアクセスしたりする場合でも、このコースは完全なOSINTツールキットを提供します。技術的な背景は不要で、人口の95%よりもスマートに、速く、効果的に検索する方法を学び、競争上の優位性を得ることができます。

17 Common Misconceptions About Islam

What do Muslims really believe—and how much of what we hear about Islam comes from reliable information rather than stereotypes, dramatic headlines, cultural practices, or individual behaviour?

17 Common Misconceptions About Islam is a clear, friendly, and beginner-level course designed to help non-Muslims and curious learners understand Islam more accurately. No previous knowledge of Islam, Arabic, or religious studies is required.

Throughout the course, we examine 17 widely repeated misconceptions and replace confusion with clear, balanced explanations. You will explore questions such as:

  • Is Allah a different God?

  • Do Muslims worship Prophet Muhammad?

  • What does Islam teach about Jesus and Mary?

  • Is the Quran simply a copy of the Bible?

  • Are all Muslims Arabs—and are all Arabs Muslims?

  • Does Islam deny women rights, education, or employment?

  • Can Muslim men marry an unlimited number of women?

  • Do Muslims worship the Kaaba?

  • Does Islam reject happiness, science, education, or modern technology?

  • Is Sharia only concerned with harsh punishments?

The course also teaches an essential critical-thinking skill: how to distinguish religious teachings, cultural traditions, political decisions, and personal behaviour. This helps learners avoid judging an entire religion through the actions of one person, one government, or one cultural community.

Each lesson uses simple language, relatable examples, and gentle humour to make complex subjects easier to understand. The purpose is not to pressure learners to accept a religion or to avoid genuine differences between faiths. Instead, the course encourages respectful curiosity, accurate understanding, and informed discussion.

By the end, you will have a stronger foundation for evaluating claims about Islam, checking sources and context, communicating respectfully with Muslims, and separating verified teachings from misinformation.

Bring your curiosity, your questions, and an open mind. No Arabic examination is waiting for you—and you will not be asked to memorize the Quran before lunch.
